node.title: Re: Devel::Hints compilation error on RHEL7
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Those errors look very similar to CPAN Testers results such as [http://www.cpantesters.org/cpan/report/ccd77f2c-7200-11e6-bdec-f59cfc002f90|this one], and [http://matrix.cpantesters.org/?dist=Devel-Hints+0.21|the matrix] shows that the last Perl release that the module worked on was 5.14.4, and on 5.16 and up doesn't build.

I did find a bug item, but it just says it was fixed in GitHub.

Where did you find this? Can you provide a link?

By the way, the last release of the module is almost 10 years ago now. Since it deals with Perl's internals, why do you need it?
